policy.credit: At most one earned credit per New puzzle, including identical boards across different rounds.
policy.practice: After earned credit, edited/wrong/reset/rechecked guesses preserve earned streak/best and suppress answer/badge/win/confetti reward.
policy.reveal: Sticky until New puzzle. Show retains existing explicit streak reset, even after earned credit; no same-round recredit.
policy.correction: Uncredited, unpeeked wrong answer can be corrected for one credit.
policy.history: Existing stored bests and badges are retained; no historical badge revocation.
policy.save: Existing scheduleSave calls still occur on checks; no claim of zero save writes.
